olivia: Heads-up — AtlasHealth (enterprise) reporting a regression in embeddings + rerank after the embed model swap over the weekend. They say top-5 relevance changed and rerank latency jumped from ~90ms to ~220ms for their live traffic. Case #2347 opened.

sam: OK thanks. Is this the same customer from the pilot last quarter? Do we have repro prompts or a sample query set?

olivia: Yes, same. They provided a short repro set (10 queries) and attached sample responses. Pasting the key bits inline. They were on `redwood/embed-stable-v1` -> we promoted `redwood/embed-quant-b1` on Sat night.

olivia: Customer examples (query + top3 ids+score we returned):
```
Q: "find specialist cardiologists near boston accepting new patients"
Returned (id,score): ["doc_42",0.73],["doc_19",0.60],["doc_11",0.59]
Customer expects: doc_11 > doc_42 > doc_19 (doc_11 is most relevant)
```

olivia: Another mismatch: free-text query about prior authorization workflows — doc ordering now surfaces policy summaries over step-by-step guides (customer impact: UX regressions).

tina: Thanks. Do we have embedding vectors for these doc ids before+after? Also what dims/quant settings are they using?

olivia: They attached a CSV with pre/post dot products for the top candidate set. Pre-update top score for doc_11 vs query was 0.81, post-update 0.59. Embedding model used: `redwood/embed-quant-b1` (768d, 8-bit quant). Request latency traces attached in ticket: avg embed call went from 35ms -> 120ms in p50 (they saw this when using our hosted route).

raj: pinging infra — did we change any routing that could cause extra network hops? Also need request ids to trace the exact calls.

olivia: Request sample_ts: 2026-03-18T14:03:21Z, trace id `trace-AT-9876`. I've added links in the ticket.

sam: Prioritization question — is this a P1 for product? It's enterprise, impacts relevancy & latency, but is it reproducible only for Atlas or more widely?

olivia: Atlas reports both: live user complaints and eval set failures vs their expected golden outputs. They say it started right after the embed model promotion.

tina: Quick hypothesis: quantization subtlety changed nearest-neighbor ordering for that doc distribution. Also different kernel may have impacted runtime. I can run customer queries against both model checkpoints and compute MRR / nDCG. ETA: 24h.

sam: Sounds good. Action plan: 1) tina to run repro eval (MRR/nDCG + cosine deltas) using customer set; 2) raj to pull end-to-end traces and verify routing/hyperconfig; 3) olivia to request customer's repo of doc vectors if possible and get permission to store ephemeral copy for debugging; 4) sam to create a product intake and tag for urgent embeddings regression (P1 candidate).

raj: I'll check infra perf. If latency bump is due to new kernel or memory layout with quant, we may be able to revert the promotion for Atlas while we investigate.

atlas_support_bot: Escalation created -> #escalations/atlas-2347, severity: high, owner: olivia.

olivia: Customer is asking for a rollback on their tenant if we can. They'd like a short-term mitigation (rollback or route to previous model) and a timeline.

sam: For routing rollback we need product + infra approval. If tina's repro confirms ranking drop correlated with embeddings delta, we should prioritize a tenant-level rollback while we root cause. I'll open an intake ticket and mark this High.

tina: I'll attach the eval artifact in the ticket. If we see systematic score compression due to quant, propose we add a quick model-variant fallback rule for affected tenants.

olivia: Customer asked for ETA on mitigation — requested update within 6 hours.

sam: Understood. I'll ping execs if this becomes P1. For now, sam -> will create the intake: https://redwood.atlassian/INTAKE-452 (linked). Assigning owners: @tina (ML eng) -> repro & eval, @raj (infra) -> trace & rollback feasibility, @olivia (CS) -> customer comms.

raj: If rollback is needed, I need a config flag + approval window. I can prepare a rollback playbook.

olivia: Customer prefers rollback to buy time. I'll tell them we aim to confirm next steps within 4-6 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: Thanks all. Let's reconvene in this thread with status updates. Please paste short updates only. :thumbsup:
